name: Dragonkin
traits: Medium, walking speed 25 ft., Charisma +2 and darkvision 60 ft. Heavy armor does not slow your movement. Dragonkin reach adulthood at 20 and can live past 100.
Commanding Presence grants Persuasion proficiency. Speak, read, and write Draconic and Trade Tongue.
Choose one of five dragonkin subraces. The cantrip it grants uses Charisma.
Flame or Fire grants Strength +1, produce flame and fire resistance.
Wind or Storm grants Intelligence +1, shocking grasp and lightning resistance.
Stone or Cave grants Constitution +1, blade ward and acid resistance.
Wave or Tide grants Wisdom +1, poison spray and cold resistance.
Edjet or Soldier grants Dexterity +1, shillelagh and poison resistance.

name: Shadow Fey
traits: This Midgard elven subrace adds Charisma +1 to the base elf’s Dexterity +2. Medium, speed 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft. and Perception proficiency.
Fey Ancestry grants advantage on saves against charm and bars magical sleep. Trance uses four hours of meditation in place of eight hours of sleep.
Shadow Fey Weapon Training grants rapier, shortsword, shortbow, and longbow proficiency.
Path of Shadows grants misty step in dim light, darkness, or a shadow large enough to cover you. It uses Charisma. Uses equal your Charisma modifier, minimum one, and return after a long rest.
Sunlight Sensitivity imposes disadvantage on attacks and sight-based Perception checks when you, your target, or the thing you are looking for is in bright sunlight.
Traveler in Darkness grants advantage on Intelligence (Arcana) checks about how a specific fey road or shadow road works.
Speak, read, and write Common and Elvish from the base elf and Umbral from the subrace.

name: Dust Goblin
traits: Small, speed 30 ft., Dexterity +2 and Constitution +1. Darkvision 60 ft. Adulthood starts about 12, and some recorded individuals have reached 40.
Alien Mind grants advantage on saving throws against charm and fear.
Strange and Deadly Surroundings grants proficiency in Stealth and Survival.

Twisted takes effect when you attack a creature from hiding. It makes a Wisdom save against DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Dexterity modifier. Failure makes it frightened of you until the end of its next turn.
Speak, read, and write Common and Goblin. The dust goblin dialect uses pictographs.

name: Sahuagin
traits: Medium, speed 30 ft. and swim 40 ft. Strength +2 and Wisdom +1. Adulthood starts in the late teens. The source gives no known upper lifespan.
Superior Darkvision reaches 120 ft. Limited Amphibiousness permits breathing air and water. Submerge at least once every four hours or start suffocating.
Natural Armor gives AC 12 + Dexterity modifier. Natural Attacks grants proficiency with 1d4 slashing claws and a 1d4 piercing bite.

Blood Frenzy uses a bonus action and lasts until the end of your turn. Gain advantage on melee attack rolls against a creature below its HP maximum. Uses equal your Constitution modifier, minimum one, and return after a long rest.
Shark Telepathy magically conveys simple commands to one shark within 120 ft.
Speak, read, and write Aquan and Common.
